sections.heading: Your combat profile
sections.body: The overview summarizes your character level, Combat Rating, equipment, default Essence loadout, and combat attributes.

sections.heading: Attributes
sections.body: Attributes are grouped into offense, defense, recovery, and utility. Hover an attribute name for its current explanation. Values shown here include all active modifiers, so they can change when equipment or an Essence loadout changes.

sections.heading: Improving your character
sections.body: Equip stronger gear, and new essences. Every character level also gives you +20 Health and +0.25 Power.
